lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Do you like performing?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Some of my assignments require me to do a little acting.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I have a hard time finding someone to practice my acting with, though.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: K isn't exactly a great thespian.
If I hadn't been a commander, I'd have been an actor.
Unfortunately, I'm not a trained actor either.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You don't say.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Maybe you can tag along

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: on my next mission.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Have you ever considered learning?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Let me tell you something.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Knowing how to perform can be a lifesaver

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: when you're on certain missions.
What role are you best at playing?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I'm good at playing almost anything.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: A girl immersed in unrequited love, a wealthy mademoiselle, a tramp...

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Sometimes I can even imitate animals.
Animals? How on earth do you pull that off?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I don't actually pretend to be an animal.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I hide in the bushes and imitate the sounds they make.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Sometimes, a target will respond to these sounds.
Next time I'm free, I'd love to see a demonstration.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Sure thing.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Anyway, what role would you be interested in playing?
An assassin.
A boyfriend.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: That should be easy enough.
What would I need to do?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Nothing special.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Whenever you've got a target who's behaving immorally,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: you take your axe and chop'em to bits straight away.
... That seems a bit outside the realm of acting.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You're the one who wanted to be an assassin!

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I can play the girlfriend.
How about we run through a scene now?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Okay, fine.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Ready... action!

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Darling!
Yes, my dear?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: When are you going to marry me?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I'm not getting any younger.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: My family pesters me day and night, demanding to know when I'll be wed.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You told me to wait, and I have.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: How long do you intend to keep me waiting?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Are you going to marry me or not?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Whenever I broach the issue of marriage,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: you always change the subject.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Almost all my female friends

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: have been proposed.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You don't intend on breaking up with me, do you?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Are you seeing another woman?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: If you are...
... Just a minute. Can we start again?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: What's the matter? That was good.
It was just... a lot to take in at a go.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Okay, fine.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Come by the hotel whenever you're free.
Okay.
